title: SAO/NASA ADS: astronomy and physics literature index rail for discovery/correction trajectories
summary: ADS is encoded as a physical-science source-index rail for finding papers, reports, theses, preprints, and literature connections around anomaly/correction trajectories. It is not encoded as a correctness authority.

status_history.note: Promoted in rev0021 anomaly/correction source-infrastructure pass.

subjects.name: source discovery, indexing, and literature connection

claims.claim: The SAO/NASA ADS overview describes ADS as a gateway to online astronomy and physics literature and related databases.
what_would_change_status: ADS overview changes or a better official source supersedes this scope description.

claims.claim: ADS coverage includes major journals, conference proceedings, NASA reports, PhD theses, and arXiv preprints with links to full text, making it useful for anomaly/correction source acquisition.
what_would_change_status: ADS coverage policy changes or current official documentation contradicts the coverage description.

claims.claim: In this cube, ADS is a discovery and cross-link rail, not a peer-review or truth engine; its value is finding the literature graph around anomalies and corrections.
what_would_change_status: A future infrastructure pass shows ADS should be modeled as a different class of rail.

evidence_refs.support_type: this infrastructure record defines bounded interpretation

limitations: No dynamic-count claim preserved as permanent count.

type_payload.signal_capture_model: Indexes and links astronomy/physics papers, preprints, reports, proceedings, and theses so anomaly and correction trajectories can be source-acquired across versions and venues.
outputs: Links to full text and arXiv records where available
limitations: ADS is a discovery/index rail, not an arbiter of scientific truth.
Dynamic counts and coverage surfaces require retrieval timestamps.
Not all correction-relevant materials are necessarily indexed.

handling_notes: Do not treat indexed status as endorsement.
Use ADS to find sources, not to replace source reading.

unknowns: No ADS API-source acquisition workflow yet.
No second-pass coverage audit for theses/reports/preprints.
next_actions: Add source-acquisition workflow for ADS if the physical-science lane grows.
Test ADS against OPERA/BICEP2/cold-fusion literature graphs.
